product_metadata.title: Fashioncraft Angel Design Trinket Box
features: Angel Design Trinket Box: This decorative box has a heavenly and luxurious design. This trinket box is sure to add an angelic touch to your dresser.
Event Favor: The angel decorative is a perfect favor for any Christian themed event. It makes for a great baptism favor, christening favor or any other event favor
Decorative Keepsake Box: Made with pewter finish polyresin, it is beautifully detailed with an ivory inlaid enamel filigree design; the trinket box is also accented with multiple clear rhinestones

Jewelry Box: This is the perfect box to store keepsakes, small pieces of jewelry, trinkets, rosary beads and sentimental mementos. It is sure to brighten up any plain dresser with its magnificent angel design
Packaging and Measurements: It is packaged in textured silver box, tied with a white satin ribbon and an attached angel design "For You" tag; measures 3" x 2.75" x 1”
